title: Management UI Plugin Manifest
description: Canonical manifest for Management UI plugins. This schema defines the contract between plugin authors and the runtime, marketplace, and registry. File should be named plugin.json in the plugin root.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor support.

id.description: Globally unique plugin identifier. Use kebab-case or reverse-domain notation (e.g., 'my-analytics', 'org.example.apps'). This is the canonical ID used in dependency references, the registry, and activation config.

name.description: Human-readable display name shown in the marketplace and admin UI.

version.description: Semantic version (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, optional prerelease suffix). Increment MAJOR for breaking changes to extension points or config shape.

description.description: One or two sentence summary of what the plugin does.

namespace.description: Plugin namespace for config-based activation. Typically the org or feature name (e.g., 'example-org', 'analytics'). The runtime uses app.enabledPlugins to enable/disable namespaces.

type.description: Plugin type for single-module plugins (e.g., 'app', 'sidebar', 'footer', 'config', 'theme', 'landing-page', 'navigation'). Used for per-type activation filtering. Omit when using 'modules' array.

category.description: Marketplace category for discovery and grouping.

visibility.description: Whether this plugin is publicly discoverable in the registry or restricted to specific orgs.

apiVersion.description: Minimum plugin runtime API version required, as a strict semver (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, optional prerelease). The host refuses plugins whose major mismatches the host or whose minor is higher than the host's minor. If absent, 1.0.0 is assumed. See docs/architecture/CONTRACTS.md for version semantics.

workspaceDependencies.description: Version constraints for shared runtime dependencies the plugin consumes from the host (react, react-dom, lucide-react, @opencast-mui/*). Each entry's lower-bound major must match the host's major for that dependency, otherwise the host refuses to load the plugin. Example: { "react": "^19.0.0", "@opencast-mui/plugin-system": "^1.0.0", "@opencast-mui/ui": "^1.0.0" }. See docs/architecture/CONTRACTS.md → "Shared Runtime Dependencies" for the full list and rules.

pluginDependencies.description: IDs of other plugins that must be loaded before this one (e.g., ['core-config', 'org.example.config']).

entry.description: Main .mjs entry point for single-module plugins (relative path from plugin root, e.g., 'dist/my-plugin.mjs'). Omit when using 'modules'.

css.description: CSS file for single-module plugins (relative path, e.g., 'dist/my-plugin.css'). Omit when using 'modules'.

locales.description: Directory containing locale files (relative path). Expected structure: <locales>/<i18n-namespace>/<lng>.json

i18nNamespaces.description: i18n namespace names this plugin ships translations for.

extensionPoints.description: Optional list of extension points this plugin registers at (e.g. 'apps:definitions', 'sidebar:nav-items', 'app:config:defaults'). Added in Manifest Contract 1.1 for tooling such as the marketplace and the contract-test harness. When present, the contract harness verifies each listed extension point has been populated after activation. Absent = tooling falls back to in-test declarations.

modules.description: For multi-entry plugins (e.g., an org plugin with sidebar + footer + app in one package). Each module is an independently activatable unit. When present, root-level 'entry', 'css', and 'type' are ignored.

id.description: Module identifier, unique within this plugin (e.g., 'sidebar', 'footer').

entry.description: Entry .mjs file (relative path from plugin root).

css.description: CSS file for this module. Multiple modules can share the same CSS file.

icon.description: Lucide icon name for marketplace display (e.g., 'GraduationCap', 'BarChart3', 'Puzzle').

backend.description: Backend/hybrid plugin metadata. Present when the plugin ships as an OSGi JAR with server-side code or static assets.

managementPlugin.description: OSGi Management-Plugin header value (e.g., 'example-org'). The backend uses this to discover and expose the plugin.

httpAlias.description: HTTP alias for serving static files (e.g., '/management-ui').

httpClasspath.description: Classpath for static files inside the JAR (e.g., '/static/plugins/example-org').

replacesJarScopes.description: JAR plugin scopes this .local-plugins entry replaces during dev (e.g., ['management_ui_plugin_example']). Only used in dev when a local build overrides a deployed JAR.
